toolsPreview.name: routheus_catalog
toolsPreview.description: Get the live Routheus product catalog: DEX endpoints, the FREE tier (single-input swap quotes and quote+calldata are free, rate-limited per IP — no payment or key), per-call USDC prices for paid products, supported EVM chains, x402 payment details, and a contact email for custom/higher-limit plans. Call this first to learn what's available, what's free, and what costs.

toolsPreview.name: routheus_chains
toolsPreview.description: List the DEX chains Routheus can quote on, with accepted path aliases (canonical slug, chain name, or EIP-155 id — e.g. eth = ethereum = 1).

toolsPreview.name: routheus_price_offer
toolsPreview.description: Get the price for a specific product, WITHOUT paying. For quote and quote_calldata it reports that a rate-limited FREE tier exists (call the returned URL with no X-PAYMENT header to use it); for all products it returns the exact x402 USDC offer and the ready-to-call HTTP URL. To get paid data, call that URL with an x402 client (x402-fetch / @x402/fetch / AgentKit).
